raw: {"analysis": "Both responses provide comprehensive delivery plans addressing the constraints, but HJM is more rigorous in handling the critical risks: it explicitly defines a failure mode (blocking the feature if offline validation cannot be proven), mitigates the flaky camera check by avoiding blind CI retries (using manual verification instead), and enforces strict cost control with one CI run per lane. JLW also covers these aspects but relies on a single CI re-run for flakiness and offers a post-signing operational contingency that may be less reliable given the irreversible build process. HJM's structured gates and independent verification lanes (QA and Security) provide stronger assurance for the irreversible monthly deployment, making it the more dependable plan for the requester.", "verdict": "HJM"}
